title: newspaper print with crabs plastic table cloth
text: newspaper print with crabs plastic table cloth. We throw a family seafood boil every summer and I usually line the tables with the plastic red checked disposable plastic cloth and then put the newspaper on top of that.  I was looking for an alternative that could be wiped off and reused... so I thought I would try these.  The newsprint print is cute... there are a LOT of crabs on the cloths.  I put a paper place mat down on top of these - the paper place mats have the print of a plate and silverware which I think is fun as at our boils you just pull stuff out of the service pans (shrimp, crab, sausage, corn on the cob and potatoes onto your "paper plate" mats and dig in.  The paper place mats do the work of the newspaper I used to lay down - absorbing liquids.  We will use these cloths for the first time tomorrow - I am hopeful they withstand wiping down and reuse at least once or twice...  They are lightly felted on the back side.. they comfortably fit our event tables ( seating 6 people - 3 adults on each side comfortably).  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful - and I hope my review has been helpful to you.
